'''Olga Martín-Belloso''' (born 8 July 1960{{cn|date=October 2025}}) is a Spanish food scientist and Professor at the [[University of Lleida]]. She was the first Spanish woman to join the [[International Union of Food Science and Technology]] and is President of the [[European Federation of Food Science and Technology]]. Martín-Belloso works on new technologies for food processing.

== Early life and education ==

Martín-Belloso is a native of [[Calahorra]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://iesvallecidacos.larioja.edu.es/olga-martin-belloso-y-la-conservacion-de-los-alimentos-ies-valle-del-cidacos/?lang=en|title=Olga Martín Belloso and "Conserving food" IES Valle del Cidacos {{!}} IES Valle of the Cidacos|language=en|access-date=2019-05-31}}</ref> She attended the Colegio de las Teresianas, which she graduated in 1976.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.calagurritana.es/fiestas2016/sociahonor2016.pdf|title=Olga Martín-Belloso - SOCIA DE HONOR 2016|website=Pena Calagurritana|access-date=2019-05-31|archive-date=2019-02-12|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190212011300/http://www.calagurritana.es/fiestas2016/sociahonor2016.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref> She studied [[chemical science]]s at the [[University of Zaragoza]]. She earned her bachelor's degree in 1982 and her PhD at the same institution in 1991.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.catedragrobank.udl.es/es/actualidad/la-universidad-de-lleida-preside-la-ciencia-y-tecnologia-de-los-alimentos-europea|title=La Universidad de Lleida preside la Ciencia y Tecnología de los Alimentos europea|date=2019-01-18|website=Cátedra Agrobank|language=es|access-date=2019-06-01|archive-date=2019-06-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190601093808/http://www.catedragrobank.udl.es/es/actualidad/la-universidad-de-lleida-preside-la-ciencia-y-tecnologia-de-los-alimentos-europea|url-status=dead}}</ref> She completed her PhD research at the Asociación de Investigación de Industrias de conservas vegetales (the National Technical Center of Canned Vegetables) in [[San Adrián]].

== Research and career ==
Martín-Belloso was made a professor at the [[University of Lleida]] in 1992.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.udl.cat/ca/serveis/oficina/Noticies/Premi-als-Estats-Units-per-a-una-catedratica-de-lETSEA/|title=Premi als Estats Units per a una catedràtica de l'ETSEA|website=UDL - Universidad de Lleida|language=ca|access-date=2019-05-31}}</ref> She leads the Department of Food Technology. Her interests include [[food preservation]] using pulsed electric fields and food product development.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Aguiló‐Aguayo|first=Ingrid|last2=Soliva‐Fortuny|first2=Robert|last3=Martín‐Belloso|first3=Olga|date=2010|title=High-Intensity Pulsed Electric Fields Processing Parameters Affecting Polyphenoloxidase Activity of Strawberry Juice|journal=Journal of Food Science|language=en|volume=75|issue=7|pages=C641–C646|doi=10.1111/j.1750-3841.2010.01735.x|pmid=21535531|issn=1750-3841}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Soliva-Fortuny|first=Robert|last2=Elez-Martínez|first2=Pedro|last3=Martín-Belloso|first3=Olga|last4=González-Casado|first4=Sandra|date=2018-04-25|title=Application of pulsed electric fields to tomato fruit for enhancing the bioaccessibility of carotenoids in derived products|journal=Food & Function|language=en|volume=9|issue=4|pages=2282–2289|doi=10.1039/C7FO01857F|pmid=29560977|issn=2042-650X|doi-access=free|hdl=10459.1/63080|hdl-access=free}}</ref> Martín-Belloso has studied coatings, including emulsion based nanostructures, that incorporate [[active ingredient]]s such as [[antimicrobial]]s, anti-browning compounds and texture enhancers.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Rojas-Graü|first=María Alejandra|last2=Soliva-Fortuny|first2=Robert|last3=Martín-Belloso|first3=Olga|date=2009-10-01|title=Edible coatings to incorporate active ingredients to fresh-cut fruits: a review|journal=Trends in Food Science & Technology|volume=20|issue=10|pages=438–447|doi=10.1016/j.tifs.2009.05.002|issn=0924-2244}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Salvia-Trujillo|first=Laura|last2=Artiga-Artigas|first2=María|last3=Molet-Rodríguez|first3=Anna|last4=Turmo-Ibarz|first4=Ana|last5=Martín-Belloso|first5=Olga|date=2018-11-26|title=Emulsion-Based Nanostructures for the Delivery of Active Ingredients in Foods|journal=Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems|volume=2|doi=10.3389/fsufs.2018.00079|issn=2571-581X|doi-access=free|hdl=10459.1/69152|hdl-access=free}}</ref>

* {{Cite book|title=Advances in Fresh-Cut Fruits and Vegetables Processing (Food Preservation Technology)|last=Martín-Belloso|first=Olga|publisher=CRC press|year=2010|isbn=978-1420071214}}

=== Awards and honours ===
Her awards and honours include;

* 2009 [[Catalan Institution for Research and Advanced Studies|ICREA]] Academy Award<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://www.udl.cat/ca/serveis/oficina/Noticies/Medalla-Narcis-Monturiol-per-a-la-catedratica-Olga-Martin/|title=Medalla Narcís Monturiol per a la catedràtica Olga Martín|website=UDL - Universidad de Lleida|language=ca|access-date=2019-05-31}}</ref>
* 2018 [[Generalitat de Catalunya]] [[Narcís Monturiol]] medal<ref name=":1" />
* 2015 Fellow of the [[Institute of Food Technologists]]<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.tecal.udl.cat/es/noticias/noticia_0007.html|title=Olga Martín, nueva Fellow del Institute of Food Technologists: La designación IFT Fellow es un honor otorgado a un miembro de IFT por sus pares, reconociendo la profesionalidad ejemplar en el campo de la ciencia de los alimentos. En un año concreto, no más del 0,3% de los miembros del IFT es elegible, y es aún menor el procentaje de miembros que alcanza ese honor. El candidato debe ser un miembro profesional del IFT y llevar en la práctica activa de la profesión durante al menos 15 años|website=www.tecal.udl.cat|access-date=2019-05-31|archive-date=2019-05-31|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190531163002/http://www.tecal.udl.cat/es/noticias/noticia_0007.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* 2019 Núvol Scientists You Should Know<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nuvol.com/noticies/25-cientifiques-que-has-de-coneixer/|title=25 científiques que has de conèixer|website=Núvol|language=ca|access-date=2019-05-31|archive-date=2019-05-31|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190531163002/https://www.nuvol.com/noticies/25-cientifiques-que-has-de-coneixer/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
